description: Sonic 2 website hero loop: multi-zone montage, hard cuts, fade at the loop ends.

shots.label: Aquatic Ruin Act 1: waterfall and log bridge
Casino Night Act 1: slot machine jackpot
shots.note: The recorded CNZ1 route into the slot cage at frame 1522. SlotMachine_Routine3 draws the target faces from the low byte of V_int_run_count; the declared starting count makes that byte $00 at cage entry, which SlotTargetValues maps to three jackpots (+150 rings). The recorded movie lands on the fallback (no prize).

shots.label: Special Stage 1: half-pipe
shots.note: EHZ1 played from its recorded level start; the stage is entered at the star post by the movie's own input.

shots.label: Metropolis Act 2: rewind out of the lava
shots.note: Positioned before the lava pit by the giant cog where trace mtz2 loses 71 rings at row 6024, carrying that ring count. Sonic falls in and scatters the rings; the live rewind runs the fall backwards, rings and all, and he walks back off the ledge.

shots.label: Mystic Cave Act 1: spiked stairs
shots.note: Positioned left of the Obj76 sliding spike stairs so they load as the camera scrolls in; 20 rings for the HUD only. Sonic jumps onto each block as its spiked face reaches him; Tails, copying his input 16 frames late, takes the spikes.

shots.label: Emerald Hill Act 2: the drill car against a crowd of Sonics
shots.note: Positioned before the boss arena with twelve Sonic sidekicks and 50 rings, since no single-act fixture reaches this boss. The leader paces so the chain spreads across the arena; the drill car plows through it and scatters the leader's rings, then returns and flashes as the jumping Sonics hit it.

shots.label: Chemical Plant Act 1: Knuckles in Sonic 2
shots.note: Knuckles in Sonic 2 needs the Sonic 3 & Knuckles dump as well.

shots.label: Sonic 3 & Knuckles donating: Data Select, art and insta-shield in Hill Top
shots.note: Title-first capture with Sonic 3 & Knuckles donating. Declared Data Select setup: six generated Sonic 2 save slots (inputs/s2-data-select-saves.json). Start on the Sonic 2 title opens the donated S3K-style Data Select with Sonic 2 zone previews; the cursor walks to the Hill Top save and starts it, the native Sonic 2 title card is drawn, and the run right shows the donated Sonic and Tails art and, on the second jump press, the insta-shield (inputs/s2-data-select-s3k.script). max_black_seconds allows the native fade from the title into Data Select, which is black for 15 frames (0.25 s).
